description: The owner's routes for external MCP servers (P2 slice D, plan task ext-14): lib/mcp/http-api.mjs (the checks of a body, the 409 while a task runs, one write at a time, the policy kept by an upsert, the connection closed and the back-off cleared after a change, the launch state of a server without a connection, the test route, tool-policy as a patch that keeps the rest of the server and its secrets, reload) and its wiring in hub.mjs, judged by tests/verify-mcp-http.mjs against a real Hub.

mutations.name: HA-writes-while-busy
mutations.what: the routes change the servers while a task is active

mutations.name: HA-hub-busy-ignores-task
mutations.what: hub.mjs does not count the main task as busy (only workers and delegates)

mutations.name: HA-test-while-busy
mutations.what: the test route connects a server while a task is active

mutations.name: HA-approve-launch-outside-the-queue
mutations.what: an approval of a launch is not queued with the other writes (and is not checked against an active task)

mutations.name: HA-writes-concurrent
mutations.what: the writes are not run one at a time (two tool-policy requests read the same server and the later write loses the earlier rule)

patches.old: const run = this.writes.then(() => { this.#idle(); return operation(); });
patches.new: const run = Promise.resolve().then(() => { this.#idle(); return operation(); });

mutations.name: HA-unknown-key-accepted
mutations.what: a body with a key the route does not know is accepted ({fingerprint} instead of expectedFingerprint, a misspelt field)

mutations.name: HA-body-not-object
mutations.what: the module does not refuse a body that is not an object
mutations.equivalent: hub.mjs refuses every POST body that is not a JSON object (400) before any route is called, so this check of the module never sees one from the Hub

patches.old: if (!isObject(payload)) throw requestFault('The body must be a JSON object.');

mutations.name: HA-id-unchecked
mutations.what: an id that is not a server id passes to the store (it answers 404 or mcp_config_invalid instead of mcp_request_invalid)

mutations.name: HA-server-not-object
mutations.what: an upsert without a server object reaches the store

patches.old: if (!isObject(server)) throw requestFault('"server" must be an object.');

mutations.name: HA-upsert-drops-policy
mutations.what: an upsert without a policy wipes the owner's rules

mutations.name: HA-upsert-keeps-connection
mutations.what: a changed server keeps the connection opened with its old configuration

patches.old: for (const id of ids) { this.launches.delete(id); await this.mcp.disconnect(id); }

mutations.name: HA-upsert-keeps-launch-state
mutations.what: the list keeps the launch state it computed before the server changed

patches.old: for (const id of ids) { this.launches.delete(id); await this.mcp.disconnect(id); }
patches.new: for (const id of ids) { await this.mcp.disconnect(id); }

mutations.name: HA-change-keeps-backoff
mutations.what: a change does not read the file again, so the back-off of a failed server stays

mutations.name: HA-launch-state-from-status
mutations.what: the list says a stdio server is approved when any record was approved, even one that changed since (status() alone)

mutations.name: HA-approve-keeps-launch-state
mutations.what: after an approval the list keeps the launch state it computed before

patches.old:
const answer = await this.mcp.approveLaunch(id, { expectedFingerprint });
      this.launches.delete(id);

mutations.name: HA-approve-keeps-refused-attempt
mutations.what: after an approval the list still shows the attempt that was refused for want of it (needs_launch_approval, not approved)

mutations.name: HA-test-never-relists
mutations.what: the test of a connected server does not list it again (a changed list is not seen)

patches.old:
if (this.mcp.connections.get(id)?.state === 'connected') await this.mcp.listTools(id, { refresh: true });
      else await this.mcp.connect(id);

mutations.name: HA-test-code-flattened
mutations.what: the test route reports every failure as mcp_connect_failed (the owner is not told the launch needs approval)

mutations.name: HA-test-always-ok
mutations.what: the test route says ok when the connection failed

patches.old: return { ok: error === null, error, status };

mutations.name: HA-test-error-unmasked
mutations.what: the error the test route returns is not passed through the Hub's masker
mutations.equivalent: every error that reaches the test route is already masked: the client manager redacts a failed connect with the Hub's and the connection's secrets (#failed), and a configuration fault names variables, never their values; the suite's Authorization secret stays out either way

mutations.name: HA-unknown-server-not-404
mutations.what: a route on a server that is not configured goes on (delete answers deleted)

mutations.name: HA-policy-unknown-server
mutations.what: tool-policy of a server that is not configured fails with a 500 instead of 404

mutations.name: HA-policy-empty-accepted
mutations.what: tool-policy with neither default nor tools is accepted

patches.old: if (fallback === undefined && tools === undefined) throw requestFault(

mutations.name: HA-policy-word-unchecked
mutations.what: a word that is not ask, allow, deny or null reaches the store

mutations.name: HA-policy-tools-array
mutations.what: an array of words is read as rules for tools named 0, 1 ...

mutations.name: HA-policy-too-many
mutations.what: one body may set more than 256 rules

mutations.name: HA-default-null-kept
mutations.what: null does not clear the default

mutations.name: HA-rule-null-kept
mutations.what: null does not clear a rule

mutations.name: HA-rules-replaced
mutations.what: a tool-policy body replaces the rules instead of adding to them

mutations.name: HA-policy-drops-secrets
mutations.what: tool-policy sends a secret back as its (absent) value instead of keeping it

mutations.name: HA-policy-resets-timeouts
mutations.what: tool-policy saves the server with the default timeouts

mutations.name: HA-policy-resets-trust
mutations.what: tool-policy drops the owner's trust in the server's annotations

mutations.name: HA-policy-drops-headers
mutations.what: tool-policy saves an HTTP server without its headers

mutations.name: HA-description-uncut
mutations.what: the list carries a long tool description whole

mutations.name: HA-rule-invented
mutations.what: a tool without a rule is shown with the rule ask

mutations.name: HA-word-defaults-to-allow
mutations.what: a tool with no rule and no default is shown as allowed

mutations.name: HA-reload-keeps-connections
mutations.what: reload leaves the open connections running with the old configuration

mutations.name: HA-reload-error-unrecorded
mutations.what: a file that could not be read is not reported by the list

patches.old:
catch (error) { this.loadError = { code: error.code ?? 'mcp_config_invalid', message: this.mask(String(error.message ?? error)).slice(0, 500) }; throw error; }
      this.loadError = null;

mutations.name: HA-reload-error-kept
mutations.what: the error of a failed reload stays after a reload that worked

mutations.name: HA-reload-keeps-launch-state
mutations.what: after a reload the list keeps the launch state computed from the file read before
